basic_details.job_title: KHADC Land Recording Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council, Shillong (KHADC), Meghalaya, has invited applications for the post of Land Recording Officer under Advt No. DC.I/28/2026/2. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's degree or higher in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), Surveying, Geomatics, Geography, Geology, Land Management or allied disciplines, with a minimum of two years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's degree or higher in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), Surveying, Geomatics, Geography, Geology, Land Management or allied disciplines; minimum two (2) years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) | Other conditions: | Should be well acquainted with customary land laws, traditional land tenure systems and local land administration practices Proficiency in modern survey equipment and software including GPS/GNSS, Total Station, GIS platforms and digital mapping tools Strong documentation and record-management skills; ability to engage with local communities and stakeholders Good analytical, communication and reporting skills

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 55,500 - Rs. 1,16,200 per month (Level-17) plus usual allowances

pattern_table.Subject: General English; General Knowledge; Aptitude Test and Reasoning; Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India; Customary land laws, traditional land tenure systems and local land administration practices in Khasi Hills Autonomous District

Foundational knowledge of RS & GIS, Geomatics, Earth Sciences, Land Management and traditional surveying methods; modern land surveying, drone surveying, cadastral mapping and GIS-based land records management; operation of modern survey instruments and GIS tools

exam_pattern.details: Candidates must produce hard copy of Admit Card at the examination centre.

how_to_apply: Complete the application in standard form in all respects.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and three recent passport-size photographs.
Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.
Furnish a valid contact number, WhatsApp number and email address.
Submit the application at Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong by 15-12-2026 during office hours.
Candidates in Central/State Government or PSU service must apply through proper channel with an NOC.
important_instructions: There will be no ineligibility list; ineligible candidates are summarily rejected without further information Incomplete applications containing incorrect or misleading information shall be summarily rejected Original certificates must be produced for verification whenever required; failure may result in disqualification No application shall be entertained after the last date

content_sections.text: Last date: 15 December 2026 Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: All candidates: Rs. 500 (Demand Draft, non-refundable) Pay: Rs. 55,500 - Rs. 1,16,200 per month (Level-17) plus usual allowances Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) Place: Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council, Shillong

content_sections.heading: KHADC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DC.I/28/2026/2 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KHADC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree or higher in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), Surveying, Geomatics, Geography, Geology, Land Management or allied disciplines; minimum two (2) years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork Experience: A minimum of two (2) years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) Other conditions: Should be well acquainted with customary land laws, traditional land tenure systems and local land administration practices Proficiency in modern survey equipment and software including GPS/GNSS, Total Station, GIS platforms and digital mapping tools Strong documentation and record-management skills; ability to engage with local communities and stakeholders Good analytical, communication and reporting skills

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not belonging to the Scheduled Tribe Community of Meghalaya. Candidates unable to speak, read and write Khasi Language.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application Forms (during office hours)

content_sections.heading: How Will KHADC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (two papers of 100 marks each, 3 hours each) Personal interview Admit cards issued in soft copy through registered email addresses and WhatsApp numbers; hard copy to be produced at the examination centre Written examination of two papers carrying 100 marks each, three hours each Paper I: General English, General Knowledge, Aptitude Test and Reasoning, Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India, customary land laws and land administration practices in Khasi Hills Autonomous District Paper II: RS & GIS, Geomatics, Earth Sciences, Land Management, traditional and modern surveying, cadastral mapping, survey instruments and GIS tools Candidates appear for written examination and personal interview at their own expense

content_sections.heading: KHADC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must produce hard copy of Admit Card at the examination centre.

rows.subject: General English; General Knowledge; Aptitude Test and Reasoning; Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India; Customary land laws, traditional land tenure systems and local land administration practices in Khasi Hills Autonomous District

Foundational knowledge of RS & GIS, Geomatics, Earth Sciences, Land Management and traditional surveying methods; modern land surveying, drone surveying, cadastral mapping and GIS-based land records management; operation of modern survey instruments and GIS tools

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents Three (3) recent passport-size photographs Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch No Objection Certificate from the concerned authority, for applicants in Central/State Government or PSU service

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Complete the application in standard form in all respects. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and three recent passport-size photographs. Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch. Furnish a valid contact number, WhatsApp number and email address. Submit the application at Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong by 15-12-2026 during office hours. Candidates in Central/State Government or PSU service must apply through proper channel with an NOC.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: There will be no ineligibility list; ineligible candidates are summarily rejected without further information Incomplete applications containing incorrect or misleading information shall be summarily rejected Original certificates must be produced for verification whenever required; failure may result in disqualification No application shall be entertained after the last date

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Land Recording Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Standard form) and send it to Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong, by by hand at the office address, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 500 (Demand Draft, non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 55,500 - Rs. 1,16,200 per month (Level-17) plus usual allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree or higher in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), Surveying, Geomatics, Geography, Geology, Land Management or allied disciplines, with a minimum of two years of practical experience in modern land surveying, cadastral mapping, GIS-based land records management or related fieldwork.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Should be well acquainted with customary land laws, traditional land tenure systems and local land administration practices. Proficiency in modern survey equipment and software including GPS/GNSS, Total Station, GIS platforms and digital mapping tools. Strong documentation and record-management skills; ability to engage with local communities and stakeholders. Good analytical, communication and reporting skills.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not belonging to the Scheduled Tribe Community of Meghalaya. Candidates unable to speak, read and write Khasi Language.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination (two papers of 100 marks each, 3 hours each). Personal interview. Admit cards issued in soft copy through registered email addresses and WhatsApp numbers; hard copy to be produced at the examination centre. Written examination of two papers carrying 100 marks each, three hours each.
